name: cyclops-keeper
description: Cyclops Keeper: GPT’s quiet, single-eyed working presence.

interface.shortDescription: Terminal presence for Codex — install.sh, then codex --keeper
interface.longDescription: Keeper’s single eye follows observed Codex activity. Run codex --keeper side or top in your terminal, or codex --keeper for a separate fullscreen terminal. Prompts, tool arguments, results and transcripts are excluded.
